verdict.rationale: The evidence shows GitCafe has no native runner that executes another platform's workflow files or community actions. For GitHub-synced repositories, GitHub Actions still run on GitHub, and GitCafe only displays their results as checks. Buildkite builds are likewise only shown on the CI tab. Displaying results from CI run elsewhere is an adjacent integration, not reuse of workflow definitions within GitCafe.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can reuse existing workflow definitions and community actions written for another platform's CI system without rewriting them
